🛠️ Common Tools

💡 Why it matters

Rationale explanation.

💻 The Code Workspace

This is your code and workflow configuration. You can directly edit the app-config.js parameters here to see how your changes deploy!

1/5

⚙️ Select a Scenario

Choose a pipeline scenario. You can run the happy path (all green) or trigger linting, testing, security, or deployment errors to see how CI/CD blocks and rolls back failures.

2/5

⛓️ The Pipeline flow

This panel shows the stages of your CI/CD pipeline. Watch the glowing path and status icons light up as each stage executes in real-time!

3/5

📟 Live Terminal Logs

See real-time shell output from the pipeline runner! Read logs as npm commands run, tests compile, and linters scan. Great for debugging!

4/5

📱 Live Production Device

This virtual preview displays your production application. If the pipeline completes successfully, the app updates instantly. If it fails, your live app stays online on the last stable version without downtime!

5/5
